entities.name: Kenan Sahrmal
entities.description: A planeswalker native of Shandalar, the Champion of Shandalar and author of the Book of Rings.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: Sahrmal's home plane, conquered by Lim-Dûl's undead army.

entities.name: Book of Rings
entities.description: A book written by Sahrmal and read by his followers.

entities.name: Bani Bakur
entities.description: A follower of Sahrmal whom he protected from Lim-Dûl.

entities.name: Faralyn
entities.description: A planeswalker killed by Sahrmal after escaping to Shandalar from the Summit of the Null Moon.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: A planeswalker who assaulted Shandalar and was sent away by Sahrmal.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: A planeswalker who assaulted Shandalar and was sent away by Sahrmal.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: A necromancer who attacked Sahrmal and later conquered Shandalar with an undead army.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl's War
entities.description: The war in which Lim-Dûl conquered Shandalar city by city with undead.

entities.name: Azar
entities.description: Sahrmal's adept who stole a spell and had his body trapped with Lim-Dûl's spirit.

entities.name: The Guardian
entities.description: Sahrmal's other student, made immortal and proclaimed his successor as protector of Shandalar.

entities.name: Ardestan
entities.description: The last remaining city of Shandalar, besieged by Lim-Dûl.

entities.name: Great Barrier
entities.description: A barrier around Shandalar that depends on the confinement of Lim-Dûl.

entities.name: Summit of the Null Moon
entities.description: Place from which Faralyn escaped to Shandalar.

events.summary: Sahrmal kills Faralyn after she escapes to Shandalar from the Summit of the Null Moon.
events.quote: Sahrmal killed Faralyn just after the other planeswalker escaped to Shandalar

events.summary: Sahrmal fights Tevesh Szat, Leshrac and Lim-Dûl in their first assault, sending the first two away.
Weakened, Sahrmal is attacked by Lim-Dûl while protecting Bani Bakur; his body disappears but he survives, nearly without magic, and his followers behead Lim-Dûl.
Twelve years later Lim-Dûl, who also survived, conquers Shandalar with an undead army until only Ardestan remains.
Sahrmal counsels patience, but Azar leaves their sanctuary to defend Ardestan, and Sahrmal and his other apprentice follow.
Azar casts a stolen spell to imprison Lim-Dûl's spirit in his body; Lim-Dûl's counter traps both spirits in Azar's body.
events.quote: The combined spells had the unforeseen effect of trapping both spirits within Azar’s body.

events.summary: Sahrmal secretly buries the body to preserve the Great Barrier, makes his other pupil immortal, and proclaims him successor before vanishing; the student declares himself the Guardian.
events.quote: “I am the Guardian, immortal protector of Shandalar.”
